title: THE FORGE · UNBROKEN CHAINS
vibe: 50 min · green · hard · full body · 5 chains, bells never touch the floor mid-chain, every chain onto a hill leg
why: Full body by construction: every station is a CHAIN of 2-3 lifts run unbroken, so each lap hits hinge, squat, press, pull and ground. Three straight days of flat legs, so the run axis moves to grade — 6.0 mph, climbing 6% / 8% / 10% by lap.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 7 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: Moves Method Day A · shoulders + spine for the overhead chains

blocks.title: THE FORGE · 30 MIN AMRAP
blocks.meta: 5 CHAIN STATIONS · TARGET 12 CHAINS · STRETCH 15 · 2×40 lb · 40 lb · 50 lb
blocks.format: AMRAP 30:00 · each station is ONE unbroken chain · finish the chain, then run the leg · count chains finished
blocks.workRest: Legs are 0.12 mi. LAP 1 (chains 1–5) 6.0 @ 6%. LAP 2 (chains 6–10) 6.0 @ 8%. LAP 3 (chains 11–15) 6.0 @ 10%. Set the grade once per lap.

items.name: C1 · IRON CHAIN 2×40 — high pull ×5 → thruster ×5 → jerk ×5 → HILL LEG
items.detail: bells stay in the hands all 15 reps

items.name: C2 · GROUND CHAIN 40 lb — get-up ×1/side → windmill ×4/side → HILL LEG
items.detail: stand up out of the get-up straight into the windmill

items.name: C3 · DEVIL CHAIN 2×40 — devil press ×8 → HILL LEG
items.detail: burpee to the bells, snap them overhead in one arc

items.name: C4 · POWER CHAIN 2×40 → bodyweight — deadlift ×10 → squat jump ×10 → HILL LEG
items.detail: drop the bells and jump immediately

items.name: C5 · UPPER CHAIN 50 lb — pullover ×10 → rear delt fly ×10 → HILL LEG
items.detail: on the floor, no rest between the two

blocks.noteGreen: Log chains finished at 30:00, RPE, and which grade started winning.
blocks.text: ★ HIGH PULL — hinge, snap, elbows high and wide. ★ JERK — quick knee bend, drive, catch with locked elbows. ★ WINDMILL — back leg straight, eyes on the bell. ★ DEVIL PRESS — one continuous arc, no press-out. ★ HILL LEG — step on moving, short quick stride.
